cli_build: cargo bench -p release-plz --bench update --no-run (default all-static and docker-tests features)
serialization: All builds and timed runs held flock /workspace/perf-cpu.lock; fresh candidate builds touched all workspace Rust sources before Cargo to avoid shared-target stale artifacts.
cli_harness: PR3143 crates/release_plz/benches/update.rs plus cli-binary-override.patch; each timed sample validates output versions, changelogs, and clean no-op status.
cli_timing: Three interleaved before/after runs per scenario, with pair 2 running the candidate before baseline; 10 Criterion samples each. summary percentages use median of three central estimates.
config_harness: Configured workspace default has changelog path, tag name, custom minor regex, custom major regex; one overridden package and one missing-override fallback. Exact outputs asserted, then 10000 warmup lookups and 8000000 timed lookups per case.
workspace_harness: Actual private new_workspace_version method, unchanged 1.0.0 packages, 100 or 1000 packages, all/quarter/zero inheritors. Setup is outside timing; manifest read/parse is included; results asserted. 10000 iterations for 100 members, 1000 for 1000 members, 100000 for empty inheritor controls.
interpretation: Focused config/workspace metrics are method costs, not end-to-end update improvements. Empty-inheritor timings are controls with no consistent gain. Strace command counts are separate from untraced wall-clock results.
unit_timing: Initial three independent runs per revision were followed by three interleaved before/after pairs, reversing pair 2. Use interleaved-unit-summary.json and unit-paired-*.log for final unit figures; summary.json preserves earlier independent runs.
zero_inheritor_controls: Final 100-member control median 3.324 -> 3.307 us; 1000-member control median 3.411 -> 4.844 us, with all three 1000-member pairs slower. Initial independent 1000-member control showed 3.442 -> 3.580 us. No zero-inheritor or universal speedup is claimed.

focused_checks.status: passed; parent handles aggregate workspace checks
